properties.TITLE: Laguna Madre Channel - Brownsville Channel/General/Hazards To Navigation/Hazards
properties.DESCRIPTION: Brownsville Ship Channel - Dismantle and Disposal of Former U.S. Naval Vessels --- From: 2025-02-03 To: 2027-12-31 --- The International Shipbreaking Limited facility, located adjacent to the Brownsville Ship Channel, is actively dismantling and disposing of U.S. Navy ships.  All passing vessels, including tour boats, fishing vessels, and recreational vessels, should remain in the channel and away from shipbreaking activity due to potential hazards associated with overhead industrial work.  POC: (956) 831-2299,  Email: arnie.tyler@internationalshipbreaking.com or daniel.l.richardson20.civ@us.navy.mil
